findings.evidence: Under the heading "Page props are Promises (Next.js 15+)", the reference says "After next dev, next build or next typegen, the global PageProps<'/users/[id]'> helper types both props". Route-aware PageProps/LayoutProps helpers and next typegen require Next.js 15.5+, so this branch offers unavailable APIs on 15.0–15.4.
findings.fix: Distinguish Next.js 15.0–15.4 from 15.5+: retain the explicit Promise-typed props shown above on earlier minors, and offer generated PageProps/LayoutProps and next typegen only on 15.5+. Apply the same availability gate to the validation guidance.

findings.evidence: "Before fixing by hand, on a clean git tree run npx types-react-codemod@3.5.3 preset-19 ./src" hard-codes ./src. Following the React 19 migration branch in a supported Next.js project with root-level app/ and no src/ makes this mandatory command fail before applying any transforms.
findings.fix: Resolve the actual source roots from the project layout and tsconfig before invoking the codemod; pass app/, components/, src/, or the relevant package directories as appropriate. Keep the pinned version, clean-tree prerequisite, diff review and typecheck gates, and update the reference checklist consistently.

findings.evidence: "React 19-only app: ref is an ordinary prop" introduces basic Button and LibButton implementations that repeat SKILL.md's native-props and ref decision tables. These standard wrapper examples add little beyond the already-loaded instructions; the generic forwardRef inference recovery below them supplies the substantive knowledge delta.
findings.fix: Remove the basic Button/LibButton walkthrough from this reference and retain the generic call-signature recovery example and its inference caveats.

findings.evidence: The assertion "Changes loaderDeps to return only page and sort instead of the whole search object" uses tanstack-products.tsx, whose search schema contains only page and sort. Returning the entire search object therefore has the same dependency keys, so this fixture cannot demonstrate the unrelated-search-key reload defect.
findings.fix: Add an unrelated validated search field such as locale to the fixture, leave the loader dependent only on page and sort, and assert that loaderDeps excludes locale. Include a check that changing locale alone does not change the loader dependency/cache key.
